question_patterns: 為什麼影子有時候長有時候短
first_sentence: 影子出現，是因為身體擋住了光。
facts: 光是直直走的，碰到東西就會被擋住
太陽高高的時候，影子比較短
太陽低低的時候，影子會拉得比較長
ask_back: 你猜早上的影子，比中午的長還是短？

bridges.has_dog: 狗狗在太陽下跑，影子也會跟著跑喔。

author: claude-haiku

question_patterns: why do I have a shadow
why does my shadow follow me
why is there a dark shape on the ground
en.first_sentence: A shadow appears because your body blocks the light.
facts: Light goes in straight lines, so it cannot go around you.
When the sun is high, your shadow is short.
When the sun is low, your shadow gets very long.
en.ask_back: Do you think a shadow is short at noon, or long?

bridges.has_dog: Your dog has a shadow too! Did you see it on the ground?
